{{Icon|Breach icon|'''Breach'''}} is a type of debuff and damage instance applied to enemies in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When an operator applies Breach to an enemy that is not currently {{G|Vulnerable}}, a stack of Vulnerability is applied instead. Otherwise, it consumes all Vulnerability stacks on the target and applies '''Breached''': Deals {{Color|100 – 250% ATK|1d}} {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} of the triggering operator and applies {{Color|Additional Physical DMG Taken|2}} {{Color|+12 – 24%|1d}} for {{Color|12 – 30|1d}}s.

The following table shows the amount of damage dealt to the target, the efficacy of the debuff, and the duration of the debuff based on the {{G|Status Level}} or the number of stacks consumed:

== Calculations ==
===Physical DMG Instance ===
{{Main|Damage calculation}}
===Additional Physical DMG Taken ===
{{Main|Arts Intensity}}

<math>{Arts\,Intensity\,Multiplier} = \dfrac{3 \times Arts\,Intensity + 300}{Arts\,Intensity + 300}</math>

Each point of Arts Intensity increases the efficacy of the debuff by some percent, at a progressively decreasing rate, up to a cap of {{Color|300%|1d}} (The effectiveness approaches 300%, but never reaches it).
